zoe_sales: Quick sync 1 QuantLabs POC needs strict EU residency (inference + logs), BYOK, and an EU-only subprocessor roster. Can we confirm feas and a short SOW snippet?
dan_se: Clarify: control-plane allowed if anonymized? Any tolerance for masked telemetry?
amelia_privsec: Customer: 'control-plane allowed only if no identifying telemetry exits EU; keys must remain under customer control (BYOK)'. I'll prepare subprocessor CSV filtered to EU and a signed attestation template.
ryan_infra: Feasible on Dedicated/Private: pin to eu-west-1, failover to eu-central-1 only. Default metrics go to metrics-us; we can enable EU sink per-tenant via toggle. Needs infra ticket.
zoe_sales: They also care about latency: target <=120ms p95, workload ~200 rps baseline with 300-400 short spikes. Need capacity/price ballpark.
dan_se: Recommend smaller batch caps and quantized model variant to hit p95.
amelia_privsec: BYOK options: KMS in eu-west-1 supported; KMIP/HSM for enterprise. No plaintext key escrow.
ryan_infra: Opened ticket EU-METRICS-1209 assigned to me, ETA 3 business days. Will attach capacity numbers (GPU count) in 48h.
ops-bot: Reminder: schedule handoff call after docs ready.
zoe_sales: Action: Amelia to send attestation + EU subprocessors, Ryan to attach capacity + infra ETA, Dan to draft SOW routing snippet. I'll consolidate for QuantLabs. :thumbsup:
